newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust prices Paxson preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust prices Paxson preferred stock.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp said on Tuesday it priced $150 million cumulative exchange preferred stock issue for Paxson Communications Corp at 12-1/2 percent.

Bankers Trust said in a statement the transaction was structured as a pay-in-kind instrument for the first six years, that it had a 10 year maturity and was exchangeable for debt with a ranking equal to the company's senior subordinated notes. The deal would be led by its subsidiary, BT Securities.
Proceeds from the offering would be used to redeem higher cost capital and fund Paxson's acquisitions and related capital expenditure program, Bankers said.
"We achieved Paxson's goal of strengthening its equity base with no dilution to the common shareholders," Art Penn, managing director of BT Securities said in a statement.
